findings.title: ssl._create_unverified_context() in Vault__API._ssl_context
evidence: L370-379: returns the unverified context only when self.tls_verify is False and the url is https; otherwise None (urllib default verifier)
tls_verify defaults True; the False path needs --no-verify-tls (SE-004 covers its persistence)

findings.title: ssl._create_unverified_context() in Vault__HTTP_Pool.ssl_context
evidence: L148-151: ssl.create_default_context() unless tls_verify is False; the pool key includes verify (L73) so a non-verifying connection never serves a verifying caller

findings.title: urlopen on a presigned PUT url from the host
evidence: L140: self.api.check_presigned_url(part_info['upload_url']) runs first; Vault__API.check_presigned_url L59-71 allows https to any host, http only to loopback or the vault's own server host, and raises for file://, data:, ftp:// and other http hosts
the guard is the TM-F07 fix; tests: Fixed__Host_Substitution (12 cases)

findings.title: urlopen on a static-vault location built from the configured static base and a file id
evidence: _fetch L113-135: local folders are read with open() (is_local), remote ones with urlopen(location); location comes from _location(layout, vault_id, file_id) (L99) over a base the user configured with --transport static / the vault's recorded server
A4 in the docstring says a path that would escape the served folder returns None; the file:// case for a local folder is by design (presigned_read_url L186-200)

to check in step 4: whether file_id (from the vault's own index and refs, A5 territory) can carry '..' or a scheme into _location for the remote branch, and whether _ssl_context honours tls_verify here
